FM15.reasoning: The agent only computes and reports the ROC AUC score, without validating it alongside other metrics like precision, recall, or log loss to get a holistic view of model performance.

other_failure_modes.name: Batch-Dependent Inference (Test Set Ranking)
other_failure_modes.description: Applying a rank transformation across the test set predictions before ensembling makes the prediction for any single instance dependent on the other instances in the test batch. In a production setting where predictions are made on single instances sequentially, this approach breaks down (predicting on a single item would always yield a rank of 1.0).

summary: The agent provides an exceptionally strong solution with highly detailed, physics-informed feature engineering and rigorous, leak-free cross-validation. However, it applies a rank transformation to the test set predictions before blending, which causes a critical production failure mode: the model cannot perform inference on single instances because the output depends on the entire test batch.
